Koporye related to Order activity and Rus counteraction in Votic territory. Holding a post required roads, food and cooperation. Nearby households protected kin and animals during military movement and sought passage or protection from competing powers. Guards arranged watches, messages and entry checks; pursuit reduced defenders. Escorts needed closing times, waiting places and arrangements for injured mounts and cargo.
